main_body: A round leafy bush/canopy blob filling the whole sprite, drawn as a mottled mass of greens with a dark outline and no trunk
top_band: none: the column scan shows only mottled green runs (L 155/94/64) alternating every 1-3 rows from the outline down, with no distinct lighter top band and no step to a front face
evidence: The sprite is a single flat disc of leaf clumps seen as a plan view. The column scans show random alternation of light, mid and dark greens, with no top band, front-edge step or separate front face (no trunk or underside shading). It reads as a flat top-down foliage slab, not a 3/4 object with a top and a south face.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 4 distinct colours (3 greens plus a black outline) and a median of 4 colours per tile, against about 108 per tile and 427-567 colours in the references. All of its dark edge pixels are neutral (100%), so the outline is a uniform near-black sticker line, while the references are 0% neutral with tinted outlines. The leaf clumps are noisy with no flat 5x5 areas, but the pattern is a random dither of three greens with no per-clump highlights, form shading or trunk. It is much shallower than the references.
